scope: preserve-C refinement after explicit owner rejection
prior_assessment_correction: Prior approval over-weighted presence of C ingredients and truthful claims; under-weighted shared photographic/material coherence.

answers.audience: People remembering family/friends and meaningful relationship context.
answers.value: Recall how you met, what matters now and dated moments.
answers.mechanism: Per-person notes/moments and manually chosen closeness.
answers.proof: Actual labeled app screens separate from illustrative images.
answers.next_action: Honest internal TestFlight status or inspect actual app.

coherence.residual: Coastal pair/location remains potentially travel/romance stock-like.

findings.issue: Polished coastal pair/location may still read as travel or romance stock
findings.fix: Keep subordinate; choose more personally specific imagery within C if owner still rejects.

capture_state: Final refreshed captures visually confirmed; no capture-pending finding.
craft_claim: Coherence materially improved and concrete render defects resolved; revised photographic character remains subject to owner judgment.

hierarchy.observation: Private iPhone category, relationship-memory promise, primary action and honest availability read before decorative details. Actual app evidence remains distinct from artwork.

typography.observation: Natural hero wraps and three separate notebook phrases restore readable rhetorical pacing. Bold system sans remains more forceful and less editorial than the comp's mixed lettering, but no longer requires awkward line grouping.

composition.observation: Quieter paper, thin landscape print, related coastal notebook, one small cup and genuine negative space form a calmer physical sequence. Final scene headline glyphs sit on the paper rather than crossing its upper edge.

identity.observation: Coral/ivory/indigo and intentional-memory materials fit Kith. The polished coastal pair/location may still suggest travel or romance rather than ordinary friendship/family context; keep it incidental, not product proof.

interaction.observation: Source provides bounded nonblocking arrival choreography, native FAQ and complete reduced-motion still states. Reduced-motion screenshot retains app and imagery; Assessment A did not exercise runtime interactions.
interaction.limitation: Runtime interaction and contrast verification belong to the separate technical/parent QA.

responsive.observation: Nine widths inspected. Smallest phones move print into flow; middle-width prints clear the native phone; notebook copy separates from the complete image below desktop. Final original screens remain visible and unmodified.

hierarchy.deduction: The large repeated Kith name and substantial artifact staging take some emphasis from the benefit/action, although category, promise, availability and next action remain clear.

typography.deduction: Type is legible and phrasing is repaired, but nearly every narrative heading uses the same forceful sans treatment; the approved memory-book study had a quieter editorial contrast between display, prose and handwritten annotation.

composition.deduction: Quieter texture, thin print and related scene now hold together. The physical hero remains a fairly rectangular upright staging and the long explanatory middle remains regular, rather than fully sharing the comp's fluid flat-lay proportions.

identity.deduction: Kith's coral/ivory/indigo and actual person constellation anchor the system, but Mediterranean coastal imagery can still be interchanged with travel/romance marketing and does not express everyday friendship/family context particularly strongly.

interaction.deduction: The intentional passive landing fit is coherent: semantic links, native disclosures, bounded arrival and complete reduced-motion states. A did not run focus, hover, download or form interactions, so this is a source/still-state judgment and not full runtime proof.
interaction.limitation: Runtime interaction QA remains separate; not claimed as independently tested by this reviewer.

responsive.deduction: No deduction for the visual scope reviewed: nine widths retain the hierarchy, readable labels, original screenshots and core actions; small prints move into flow and intermediate prints clear the app.
responsive.limitation: This is normal-scale rendered layout review; technical enlarged-text/contrast checks remain separate.

rubric_limitations: Independent static A craft review, not owner acceptance.
Interaction score judges intentional passive fit from source and rendered reduced-motion still; runtime tests belong to separate QA.
Responsive score covers nine normal-scale rendered widths; enlarged-text and measured contrast are separate technical checks.
The previous Nielsen heuristic total is not this rubric and is not used to force the craft total.
